title_zh: Colourful life — 第15节可背诵讲义
body_en: A colourful life mixes study, rest, and hobbies. Try art, music, or sport on different days. Do not fill every hour; leave space to think. Help at home and talk with family about your day. Colour comes from a calm week plan, not from rushing all the time.
body_zh: 多彩生活把学习、休息和爱好混在一起。不同日子试试艺术、音乐或运动。别把每一小时都填满，留点空间思考。在家帮忙，并和家人聊聊今天。色彩来自平静的一周计划，而不是一直赶路。
